thread:
Claire R: Candidate for SWE2 (EMEA) counters asking for \u20ac10k more than offer but explicitly prefers relocation support over base bump. They asked for: (1) keep base but add a \u20ac8k interest-free relocation loan + (2) move 2% of target bonus to guaranteed retention bonus year1 (cashable at 3 months). Wants start 2026-04-08. Deadline EOD.
Anya (People Ops): quick numbers pls (redact PII) and do we have policy precedent for relocation loan + bonus reclassification?
Dev (Hiring): Offer: base \u20ac110k + 12% bonus. Candidate counter total comp demand \u20ac120k eqv. They'd rather get relocation help and some guaranteed cash vs permanent base bump. Hiring says this helps keep band integrity.
Marta (Comp): We sometimes do one-off relocation advances but reclassifying bonus to guaranteed cash is unusual. Need Comp memo + VP sign-off + Finance + Legal for loan docs. Suggest cap: relocation loan <= \u20ac10k, repay over 6-12 months, and retention cash limited to 50% of target bonus in year1 and timeboxed. Clawback if they leave within 12 months.
FinanceBot: Automated check: "Action: relocation loan (non-taxable advance?) + reclassified retention cash. Required approvals: comp@, vp-engi@, finance@, legal@. Payroll/EE tax impact: loan may be taxable depending on local regs; Finance needs payroll country code and loan schedule. Estimated routing time 24-48h. Candidate deadline: EOD"
Claire R: Candidate happy with loan + 6k guaranteed year1 cash (paid at month 3) and earlier start to align school. We can fund relocation budget.
Legal: We'll need a signed loan agreement and repayment schedule with clawback language. Also confirm whether loan counts as taxable income in country; may require gross-up. Can draft template quickly but need country specifics.
Anya (People Ops): Draft messaging option: keep base \u20ac110k, offer interest-free relocation loan \u20ac8k repayable over 8 months starting month 2, plus guaranteed retention payment \u20ac6k payable after 3 months conditional on continuous employment; condition: final comp review to consider permanent band uplift by 2026-06-15, with clawback if employee leaves <12 months. Sending comp memo request to Marta and routing to VP + Finance + Legal.
Marta (Comp): I'll draft exception memo recommending loan + timeboxed retention cash as it preserves base band. I'll include recommended clawback and tax note. Tagging @VP Eng for expedited approval.
Dev (Hiring): I'll ping VP and confirm hiring discretionary funds. Also will tell candidate we can propose a structured relocation loan + retention payment pending approvals so they can start relocation plans.
offer-bot: Automated check: "Routing created: comp -> vp-engi -> finance -> legal. Candidate note suggested: 'provisional relocation assistance + retention payment pending approvals; expect final decision tomorrow AM'."
Claire R: thanks all 44aa. Logging to exceptions tracker and attaching redacted comp docs.
